description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot', a framework for creating various types of plots within the PEAR Image_Graph library. It includes methods for handling datasets, markers, data selection, and rendering plot elements, supporting different plot types like normal, stacked, and 100% stacked.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot
classes.description: Framework class for rendering different types of plots in the PEAR Image_Graph library, supporting multiple datasets, plot types, markers, and legend rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the plot with dataset(s), plot type, and title.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the plot for legends.

methods.name: _mergeData
methods.description: Merges URL and HTML data into point data for rendering.

methods.name: _setAxisY
methods.description: Sets the Y axis (primary or secondary) for the plot.

methods.name: setMarker
methods.description: Assigns a marker object for data points.

methods.name: setDataSelector
methods.description: Sets a data selector to filter which data points are displayed.

methods.name: _getMarkerData
methods.description: Calculates marker position data based on dataset points and plot type.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws markers on the canvas for data points.

methods.name: _minimumX
methods.description: Returns the minimum X value across datasets.

methods.name: _maximumX
methods.description: Returns the maximum X value across datasets.

methods.name: _minimumY
methods.description: Returns the minimum Y value across datasets.

methods.name: _maximumY
methods.description: Returns the maximum Y value across datasets.

methods.name: _pointX
methods.description: Converts a data value to pixel X coordinate, using parent method.

methods.name: _pointY
methods.description: Converts a data value to pixel Y coordinate, using parent method.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates plot coordinates based on parent container.

methods.name: dataset
methods.description: Returns the dataset(s) associated with the plot.

methods.name: _getTotals
methods.description: Calculates and returns total/min/max values for datasets.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample rectangle for the legend.

methods.name: _legendSample
methods.description: Draws a legend sample including marker if applicable.
